'''April 2000 St. Cloud tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Java Z, St. Cloud, Minnesota on 15 April 2000. [[Graham Neal]] won it. It is known from Peter Jacobson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d550">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-st-cloud-mn-java-z-4-15-00d550/ st-cloud-mn-java-z-4-15-00], DeckTech (Peter "jeeps" Jacobson, 18 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-st-cloud-mn-java-z-4-15-00d550/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Java Z, St. Cloud, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 20
* '''Winner:''' [[Graham Neal]]
